data.one_liner: Dart wrapper for OpenMLS implementing the Messaging Layer Security protocol
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart and Flutter wrapper for the OpenMLS Rust implementation of the Messaging Layer Security (MLS) protocol (RFC 9420). Enables secure group messaging with forward secrecy, post-compromise security, and encrypted state storage.
use_when: Building end-to-end encrypted secure group messaging applications
Needing compliance with the Messaging Layer Security (MLS) protocol (RFC 9420)
Requiring hybrid and post-quantum cryptographic ciphersuites in Dart or Flutter
avoid_when: Using dart2wasm target (currently unsupported due to upstream limitations)
Needing simple client-server messaging without end-to-end protocol encryption requirements
strengths: High performance via direct Rust integration using flutter_rust_bridge
Comprehensive implementation of the MLS protocol including tree-based group key agreement
Built-in encrypted state storage using SQLCipher on native and Web Crypto on WASM
weaknesses: Precompiled native binaries depend on target platforms and build hooks
Post-quantum ciphersuites are experimental and use provisional code points
Does not support `flutter build web --wasm` targets yet
data.setup_notes: No manual Rust compilation required for end users as precompiled binaries are downloaded automatically via build hooks.
